listing.name: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 2 — OpenKai2 (7v0biscuit)
listing.summary: Windows guide: runtime reaches level selection; complete matches/performance/gameplay unvalidated. CPU renderer, a stable 60 FPS in the game unverified; ALL host audio output disabled including movies/menus/fights. See below for original-file requirements and setup. steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Budokai 2 ISO; it is required every time you play. The supported executable SHA-256 is 431568221bb744a6affc47dc91144b24892839d4d1ab8236bee1e03d83e6b898. This guide does not include a whole-disc hash or the exact serial number and revision; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Published OpenKai2.exe self-contained portable launcher, OpenKai2-windows-x64.zip, or OpenKai2-Setup.exe; no Python/Visual Studio needed for downloaded package; owns ISO cache. Source generation/compilation only for developer route.
